title: Pasten's arithmetic derivatives and the decomposition into gains
summary: Pasten attached to each coprime triple $a+b=c$ a lattice of arithmetic derivations that obey the Leibniz rule and are additive on this one equation. An arithmetic Wronskian then gives an $abc$-type inequality governed by the norm $\|ψ\|$ of the derivation, and Pasten showed that sufficiently small derivations exist under the $abc$ conjecture and give an $abc$ inequality with a fixed exponent. We determine exactly which values this Wronskian takes, and we show that its estimate with exact prime weights has the best possible coefficient. The quality $X=\log c/\log\operatorname{rad}(abc)$…
